_comment: Pins scripts/fetch-minecraft.mjs's upstream (misode/mcmeta — a mirror of vanilla Minecraft's OWN datamined data, not a wiki) to exact commit SHAs instead of the rolling 'summary'/'assets-json'/'assets' BRANCH refs. Those branches move: during a past regeneration the resolved gameVersion silently advanced 26.3-snapshot-5 -> -6 mid-run, purely because a branch moved between two fetches in the same invocation. It changed nothing in our slice that time, but it means a regeneration was not reproducible and a future run could quietly mix an upstream data refresh into an unrelated commit. Fetching by commit SHA instead makes every source within one run (and across re-runs) read the exact same immutable content. A DELIBERATE upstream refresh (new snapshot, new recipes, ...) means re-resolving these pins ON PURPOSE: run `node scripts/fetch-minecraft.mjs --update-pins`, review the diff it prints, then re-run the scraper normally. Do not hand-edit the shas below.
